v1ThreeDimensionalView.implementation: three independently positioned orthogonal slice families
planes: XZ horizontal slices at selected Y positions
XY longitudinal slices at selected Z positions
YZ cross-room slices at selected X positions
v1ThreeDimensionalView.rangeInvariant: changing only orthogonal slice count is a visualization-topology change and must not change the shared display range or recolor the existing 2D heatmap
v1ThreeDimensionalView.mustNot: represent a single floor-level XZ slice as the complete 3D field

viewSelection.invariant: adding the 3D field view does not remove or redefine the existing 2D heatmap
